title: Recipe
description: One trusted guidance recipe: when to use a capability, what it does not do, its limits and how to read its results. Entry schema for readGuidance (decisions/0001). Recipes are operator-authored and reviewed; a recipe is never derived from ingested source, and reading one has no effect on any repository.

appliesTo.description: Which operation and mode this recipe covers, as written by the reviewer.

body.description: Full Markdown guidance. Omitted from catalog listings, present when one recipe is requested.

contentHash.description: sha256 of the exact recipe file bytes, so guidance quoted in a brief stays attributable to the reviewed revision.
